hypothesis: A stored/re-run B-04 decode that is a TRUE key but in a non-English register (Latin/Greek) or invisible to the English quadgram scorer will score above a seed-3301 order-matched null under the round16 matched-runic scorer + an EN/LA/GR rune-trigram panel, where it did not under the English-only gate. This audits the ONE adjudicator axis the ledger records as unadopted by any lane (L7-A-SCORER-ENGLISH-ONLY.not_covered[2], round19/I2.not_covered). Instrument/closure audit (doctrine R1+R6), NOT a new key-space sweep.
verdict: NULL (control-validated). The matched-runic adjudicator does NOT overturn the B-04 English-only negative on the re-adjudicated slice.
coverage: Re-adjudicated a bounded, R20-prior-ordered B-04 slice: top-40 R20-prior seeds (round20/P3/seedprior20.json, rank-1 1325734783) x 16 B-04 generators (round13/B04/ks.py) x 4 reductions (mod29/rej29/hi_nib/bits5) x 2 signs x 2 atbash x 2 seed-byte-forms (ASCII-decimal + raw big-endian), offset 0, L=120, target = real unsolved LP2 head. N = 20,480 decodes. Every decode adjudicated under EN quadgram + round16 matched-runic + EN/LA/GR rune-trigram panel, with the four R3 language-agnostic statistics (decrypt IoC.N, min distinct over 32-rune window, best panel LM, zlib compressibility) PERSISTED PER ROW at sweep time (doctrine R3; the axis L7-A-HANDOFF-NONCOMPLIANCE recorded as 0/15 for the original B-04 rows). Measured power (control): EN ~1.0, Latin 0.50 (EN) / 0.79 (matched) at fixed -5.5, Greek 1.0, EN_NOVOWEL 0.00 under both. Value = coverage(20,480 in this slice) x power(Latin 0.50->0.79, EN/Greek ~1.0, novowel 0.00).
not_covered: Seeds outside the R20-prior top-40, generators outside round13/B04/ks.py, reductions other than the 4 swept, offsets != 0, deeper R20-prior ranks - the slice is bounded, not the whole B-04 family.
Decoder transition models beyond beam_decode(max_skip=3): the ONE key-skip relation. INHERITS L7-B (skip_by_two and free drift unrepresentable) - that closure is lane C2, not this one.

Registers whose LANGUAGE none of {English quadgram, round16 matched-runic (which corrects rune ORTHOGRAPHY, not language), EN/LA/GR rune-trigram panel} models: vowel-dropped English (power 0.00 under BOTH scorers - permanent blind spot inherited from L7-A), Welsh, Hebrew, Norse, Enochian, constructed languages.
Non-linguistic payloads (B6 proved undetectable in principle; degenerate null).
threshold: Per-scorer, per-register: a decode clears iff its score exceeds BOTH (a) that register's seed-3301 order-matched wrong-key null MAX and (b) the family-wise threshold_for(N=20,480) bar from benchmark/null.py. Bars fixed in PREREG.md before scoring: EN -4.775, MATCHED -4.685, panel -1.306. Control PASS condition (fixed in PREREG): matched-scorer power > English-scorer power on >=1 non-English register at L=120.

control.rune_index_recovery: 100% on every linguistic register (decoder works; only the adjudicator was in question)
control.l7a_gap_reproduced: YES - English Latin power 0.50 (L7-A measured 0.33-0.50); matched scorer rescues ~29pp of Latin decodes (0.50->0.79). EN_NOVOWEL 0.00 under both scorers reproduces L7-A's 0.00 exactly.
control.decisive_scope_finding: The matched scorer corrects rune ORTHOGRAPHY (7 digraph expansions + K/Q->C,V->U,Z->S), NOT LANGUAGE. It rescues Latin (English-quadgram-shaped once orthography penalty removed) but not vowel-dropped English (a language gap). Its adjudicator widening is bounded by L7-A's -0.139 round-trip cost.

fp_ceiling_at_bar.note: identical, exactly the alpha=0.01 family-wise design; matched scorer does NOT inflate FP rate

red_team.double_max_hazard: not reintroduced - ONE adjudication per decode per register, ONE family-wise threshold_for per register; no sieve x panel-max compounding (R21-L5 / B-04 GATE-NOTE hazard honoured)
red_team.seal: R21-L1 SEAL would apply to any bar-clearer (FLAGGED-FOR-ORACLE, never auto-certified); no survivor to flag

result.decision_relevant: The matched-runic adjudicator is genuinely more powerful than English on Latin (L7-A gap reproduced), but turned on the strongest prior B-04 slice it yields ZERO survivors 1.6 score-units below the bar with flat IoC / incompressible decodes. The English-only B-04 negatives were NOT hiding a non-English survivor in this slice; the negatives HOLD under the corrected scorer.

reopens_if: A wider R20-prior depth, a non-zero offset, a generator/reduction outside this slice, OR a genuinely language-aware non-English adjudicator (Hebrew/Norse/Enochian LM, not merely orthography-corrected English) produces a decode clearing the seed-3301 order-matched null max AND the family-wise threshold_for(N) bar. Any survivor is FLAGGED-FOR-ORACLE (R21-L1), never auto-certified.
